changes: Cale scheduler model contributions use a per-run/per-account SQLite journal with a live native-thread owner, exact reviewed artifact hashes and durable remote mutation intents.
Verified existing forks are reused. Saved branch deltas must contain exactly the four reviewed JSON artifacts on confirmed upstream ancestry; current ref is rechecked before PR dispatch.
Uncertain PR POSTs reconcile rather than repeat. Definitive rejection and cancellation before dispatch can retry safely. Public matching metadata is required before reporting delivery.

Cached qualified upload retry is separate from new training: one-minute transactional transport claims preserve the original candidate, run ID and maximum recorded compute time. Original hourly training policy remains unchanged.
Trainer bytes stay identical to528; legacy direct trainer publisher remains for provenance compatibility. Cale scheduler uses the new donation-layer transport.
limits: Tests use real-shaped in-memory GitHub and synthetic provenance-valid artifact fixtures; no real training, donor account, PR mutation, accepted fix or model activation is claimed.
SQLite claims are local to a PC, not a distributed cross-PC lease. Ref/provenance checks are repeated observations, not an atomic GitHub compare-and-POST transaction.
Historical submitted rows are not retroactively confirmed. GitHub restrictions and anonymous visibility API limits cannot be overridden.
No full installed-suite, fresh-PC, microphone/camera/music or app-completion pass is claimed. Private unfinished app remains5/8.
